purpose: Reference input for the data phase that adds the museum's departments and collections after the pilot. Public information; not a plan and not applied by anything.

levels.department: EMu CatDepartment. A main collection. Maps to a root collection row (no parent).
levels.catalog: EMu CatCatalog. Maps to a child collection row under the department. For Botany and Anthropology the catalog equals the department, so the level is skipped.
levels.subset: EMu CatCatalogSubset. Maps to a child collection row under the catalog where the museum manages it as a sub-collection; for Insects the subsets are taxonomic orders and stay as a field, not a collection.

sources.name: Field Museum public collections search, JSON route
sources.notes: Filters by dept and catalog; returns results and total only, no facets. Values below were read from sampled records on 2026-09-22 and are not exhaustive.
